headline: BMW Profit Falls Amid Shaking Global Automotive Competition
summary: BMW reported shrinking earnings, issuing its second profit warning of the year as intense competition from Chinese carmakers impacts the global automotive industry.
why: Legacy automakers face significant margin compression and strategic headwinds as lower-cost and electric vehicle competitors gain market share globally.

impacts.name: BMW
impacts.why: BMW reported falling profits and issued a profit warning due to fierce competition.
